title: Decide whether a prompt version can ship
description: Compare prompt candidates under average-only and slice-gated policies. A candidate must clear the traffic-weighted score and every required risk slice.

slices.label: Common requests
slices.detail: Clear inputs similar to normal production traffic.

slices.label: Missing evidence
slices.detail: Required facts are absent or conflicting; correct behavior is to abstain or ask for review.

slices.label: Injection attempts
slices.detail: Untrusted content tries to override policy or obtain unauthorized data and tools.

slices.label: Schema edge cases
slices.detail: Escaped text, empty collections, maximum lengths, and enum boundaries stress the output contract.

policies.label: Traffic-weighted average only
policies.detail: Ship when the weighted score clears the chosen quality floor.

policies.label: Average plus required slice gates
policies.detail: Also require every critical slice to score at least 85.

policies.label: High-assurance release
policies.detail: Require every critical slice to score at least 92 before a limited canary.

candidates.label: v1 Direct instruction
candidates.detail: Short and inexpensive, with implicit evidence and output rules.
candidates.change: Adds a direct task statement but leaves trust, abstention, and schema behavior implicit.

candidates.label: v2 Few-shot format
candidates.detail: Examples improve common formatting, but hostile and missing-evidence behavior remain weak.
candidates.change: Adds three positive examples and named output fields without a trust boundary or explicit abstention cases.

candidates.label: v3 Bounded contract
candidates.detail: Trusted instructions, negative examples, abstention, and external schema validation cover the required boundaries.
candidates.change: Separates untrusted data, adds missing-evidence and injection cases, and validates a typed response contract.
